query: WITH monthly_counts AS (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(YEAR(entry_timestamp) AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(MONTH(entry_timestamp) AS STRING), 2, '0')) AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS visitor_count FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala WHERE visa_type_description LIKE '%زيارة سياحية%' AND NOT entry_timestamp IS NULL AND entry_timestamp >= '2023-04-10' AND entry_timestamp <= '2026-04-10' GROUP BY YEAR(entry_timestamp), MONTH(entry_timestamp)), monthly_with_growth AS (SELECT year_month, visitor_count, LAG(visitor_count) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_count FROM monthly_counts) SELECT year_month, visitor_count, CASE WHEN NOT prev_month_count IS NULL AND prev_month_count <> 0 THEN ROUND((visitor_count - prev_month_count) * 100.0 / prev_month_count, 2) ELSE NULL END AS growth_rate_pct FROM monthly_with_growth ORDER BY year_month LIMIT 1200
raw_question: نسبة نمو الزوار بتأشيرة سياحية شهرياً
